title: Book Cover Design
description: Designed a book cover concept with a focus on visual hierarchy, typography, composition and readability.
objective: Create a visually appealing and cohesive book cover that communicates the publication's theme and presents a polished visual identity.
steps: Developed the overall cover concept and visual direction.
Planned the composition, spacing and visual hierarchy.
Selected typography, imagery and supporting visual elements.
Refined alignment, spacing and readability for a polished final presentation.
results: Created a complete book cover design demonstrating typography, layout, visual hierarchy and creative design skills.

challenges.problem: Balancing the title, imagery and supporting information while keeping the cover visually clear.
challenges.solution: Applied visual hierarchy, spacing and typography choices to keep the main information prominent and the overall composition balanced.
